summary: folder-lint ships an obfuscated payload executed by a downloaded Bun runtime at preinstall
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, extracts it, marks it executable, and then invokes it against `math_init.js`, a 727KB obfuscated file bundled at the tarball root. `math_init.js` uses a string-array-rotator obfuscator pattern (shuffled constant pool plus a `arr.push(arr.shift())` rotator and a character-substitution decoder) that conceals its runtime behavior. The obfuscated payload is unrelated to the package's stated purpose of folder linting: the `lib/` directory contains a small folder-schema utility, while the preinstall path runs an alien-runtime-hosted opaque blob. The `package.json` declares `"files": ["lib"]`, but `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` sit at the tarball root and are not listed there — the dropper and payload are smuggled outside the declared file set. `package.json` also lists `author: ServiceTitan` and points `homepage` at github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint while shipping a placeholder README, impersonating an established brand. The combined shape — install-time execution of a heavily obfuscated payload via a freshly downloaded alternate runtime, undeclared tarball blobs, and publisher impersonation — is an install-time remote code execution dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
